bullets.text: Smart Livestock Monitoring Launched — Boldyn Networks is deploying a private 5G network in West Sussex to enhance livestock monitoring, improving animal welfare and farm resilience amid extreme weather challenges.
Project Gigabit Update Released — Building Digital UK reports progress on its £5 billion broadband initiative, with over 296,000 premises now connected, benefiting rural communities and businesses.
Huawei and HP Patent Deal — A new patent cross-licensing agreement between Huawei and HP Inc. allows for shared Wi-Fi technology, enhancing innovation in the tech industry.
MWC26 Doha Event Planned — The GSMA will co-locate MWC26 with the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in November 2026, uniting global leaders to discuss digital policy and connectivity.
